thread:
Maria G: heads-up — alert for webhook-processor batch-ack mismatch started firing at 02:17 UTC. looks like we acked batches 1472-1474 but cursor didn't persist, so stripe events got replayed and created ~200 orphaned invoice items.

billing-bot: alert: webhook-processor.batch_ack_mismatch count=3 service=webhooks env=prod

Ajay P: ugh. do we have logs for the commit vs. ack ordering? might be an async kube crash after ack

Maria G: grabbing logs now. short snippet:
```
INFO 2026-03-20T02:17:01Z batch=1472 ack_sent=true
ERROR 2026-03-20T02:17:01Z batch=1472 commit_err="timeout writing cursor"
INFO 2026-03-20T02:17:02Z requeued events=31 source=stripe
```

Maria G: so ack went out before cursor commit failure — processor treats ack as durable which is wrong.

Leo H: ok that's the root cause. we should never ack until after db commit. hotfix: move ack step after tx commit and add a monotonic checkpoint write. simple patch, 1-liner in consumer.go

Nadia S: can we mitigate without deploy? pause webhook delivery from stripe for the affected customer buckets? risky. alternative: add a temporary dedupe on webhook ID in the invoicer to ignore duplicates for 1h

Sam K: I can push a short-lived dedupe rule in the invoicer config; that'll block duplicate invoice creation while we patch

Ajay P: good. also we should scan DLQ for events that were processed twice and create compensating credit memos for affected invoices. I'll write query to find duplicates by stripe_event_id.

Maria G: I've pushed a temporary flag to invoicer: ignore_event_if_seen=true for the next 6 hours. routing teams notified (ops-oncall).

Leo H: patch ready: moveAckAfterCommit branch, tests added for failed commit -> no ack. planning 1.0.1-hotfix rollout to prod-canary then prod. changelog: ensure ack after commit + checkpointing.

Sam K: rolling canary now (canary pod 1/1). watching metrics: dedupe hits=0 -> 12 -> stabilizing

billing-bot: deploy: 1.0.1-hotfix started by leo-h in prod-canary

Maria G: canary looks clean for 3m; no further replays. deploying to prod in 2m

billing-bot: deploy: 1.0.1-hotfix completed in prod by leo-h

Nadia S: great. Ajay, can you share the audit list for affected invoices so finance can notify customers? finance-ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3920

Ajay P: will do. quick note: we should add a metric and an alert for ack_sent && commit_failed in the future. created issue FIN-3923

Maria G: thanks everyone. follow-ups: backfill duplicate detection script, compensating credits, postmortem in incidents channel. :thumbsup:
